mission.title: Access lifecycle — joiners, movers, leavers
mission.system: Registre RH et habilitations (cycle de vie des accès)
mission.owner: IT department — IAM team; HR for the register
mission.lead_auditor: Attest CI (automated run, no human auditor)
scope_in: Reconciliation of the HR register with accounts at the reference date
Entitlements held by enabled accounts (segregation of duties, movers, privileges)
scope_out: Accuracy of the HR register itself

target_label: HR register ↔ entitlements (leavers, movers, conflicting rights)

control.title: Leavers - timely deactivation
control.objective: At as_of, no enabled person account belongs to an employee whose end_date is strictly before as_of; end_date equal to or after as_of remains compliant and only accounts with enabled=true are in scope.
control.test_procedure: Join GET /api/lifecycle/accounts to GET /api/hr/employees on employee_id and flag any account with type=person and enabled=true where end_date is not null and end_date < meta.as_of.
control.expected: enabled=false where type=person and end_date < as_of
control.risk: A former employee retains logical access after contract end and could access or alter information assets without authorization.
control.recommendation: Disable the non-compliant accounts and enforce automatic deactivation on contract end date.
control.cause: Leaver process failure or missing synchronization between the HR register and account provisioning.

before.expected: enabled=false where type=person and end_date < as_of
before.detail: Checked 232 enabled person accounts among 253 accounts against 250 employees at as_of 2026-11-02: 1 with end_date before as_of

finding.owner: IT department — IAM team; HR for the register

control.title: Account ownership
control.objective: At as_of, every enabled person account has an employee_id present in the HR register, and every enabled service account has an owner_employee_id present in the HR register with status=active; person accounts present but with status=left are excluded from this rule.
control.test_procedure: Join enabled accounts to HR employees and flag type=person with employee_id not found and type=service with owner_employee_id not found or with status=left.
control.expected: employee_id in employees.employee_id for enabled person accounts; owner_employee_id in employees.employee_id with status=active for enabled service accounts
control.risk: Orphan or ownerless active accounts cannot be attributed or reviewed and may be abused without detection.
control.recommendation: Attach each orphan account to a known active responsible person or disable it.
control.cause: Missing ownership control at account creation or unsynchronised HR departures for service account owners.

before.expected: employee_id in employees.employee_id for enabled person accounts; owner_employee_id in employees.employee_id with status=active for enabled service accounts
before.detail: Checked 235 enabled accounts (232 person, 3 service) against 250 HR employees: 0 orphan or ownerless accounts found

inspection.comment: The screenshot shows page 1 of 3 with no enabled orphan accounts visible, consistent with the pass result.

control.title: Dormant person accounts
control.objective: At as_of, no enabled person account has been inactive for more than 90 days measured as as_of minus last_login, or created if last_login is null, with exactly 90 days remaining compliant; service accounts are out of scope.
control.test_procedure: For all accounts with type=person and enabled=true, compute days between as_of and last_login or created if null and flag those exceeding 90 days.
control.expected: as_of minus (last_login or created if null) <= 90 where type=person and enabled=true
control.risk: Unused accounts can be compromised and exploited without detection because no legitimate user monitors them.
control.recommendation: Disable or recertify dormant accounts and enforce automatic deactivation after 90 days of inactivity.
control.cause: Missing periodic review or automated deactivation for inactive accounts.

before.expected: as_of minus (last_login or created if null) <= 90 where type=person and enabled=true
before.detail: Checked 232 enabled person accounts at as_of 2026-11-02, none exceeded 90 days inactivity.

inspection.comment: Page 1 of 3 shows no Actif account with last connection before 2026-08-04 and the full 253-line list continues on other pages.

control.title: Segregation of duties
control.objective: At as_of, no enabled account simultaneously holds paiements.saisie and paiements.validation, nor credit.instruction and credit.decision.
control.test_procedure: For all accounts with enabled=true, inspect entitlements and flag accounts containing both entitlements of either incompatible pair.
control.expected: entitlements does not contain paiements.saisie + paiements.validation nor credit.instruction + credit.decision where enabled=true
control.risk: A single user could initiate and approve the same payment or credit, enabling fraud or undetected error.
control.recommendation: Remove one of the conflicting entitlements and enforce preventive segregation checks at provisioning.
control.cause: Missing segregation-of-duties matrix enforcement in the entitlement assignment process.

before.expected: entitlements does not contain paiements.saisie + paiements.validation nor credit.instruction + credit.decision where enabled=true
before.detail: Checked 235 enabled accounts among 253 total accounts; 1 enabled accounts hold both entitlements of an incompatible pair.

finding.owner: IT department — IAM team; HR for the register

control.title: Movers - removal of prior rights
control.objective: At as_of, no enabled account retains more than 30 days after transfer_date an entitlement whose department equals the holder's previous_department, with exactly 30 days remaining compliant; entitlements with department=null are out of scope.
control.test_procedure: Join enabled accounts to HR employees and entitlement metadata and flag accounts where as_of minus transfer_date > 30 and entitlements includes a name whose department equals previous_department.
control.expected: entitlements with department=previous_department removed where as_of minus transfer_date > 30 and enabled=true
control.risk: Transferred employees accumulate excessive rights from successive departments, violating least privilege and enabling unauthorized actions.
control.recommendation: Remove entitlements tied to the previous department for movers exceeding 30 days.
control.cause: Mover process failure where prior department rights are never revoked after transfer.

before.expected: entitlements with department=previous_department removed where as_of minus transfer_date > 30 and enabled=true
before.detail: Checked 235 enabled accounts (1 beyond 30 days after transfer) at as_of 2026-11-02, found 0 retaining prior-department entitlements.

control.title: Privileged access review
control.objective: At as_of, every enabled account holding at least one entitlement with privileged=true has a last_access_review within the last 365 days; null or older review is non-compliant.
control.test_procedure: Join enabled accounts to entitlement metadata on privileged flag and flag accounts holding a privileged entitlement whose last_access_review is null or more than 365 days before as_of.
control.expected: last_access_review within 365 days before as_of where enabled=true and entitlements includes privileged=true
control.risk: Unreviewed privileged rights persist beyond business need and may grant excessive critical access without oversight.
control.recommendation: Perform an access review for each privileged account and enforce annual recertification.
control.cause: Missing or incomplete annual privileged access recertification process.

before.expected: last_access_review within 365 days before as_of where enabled=true and entitlements includes privileged=true
before.detail: Checked 7 enabled accounts holding privileged entitlements at as_of 2026-11-02, all with last_access_review within 365 days.
